verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page explicitly claims it can "instantly auto-generate follow-up emails and next steps for client calls" (otter-docs-41). AI Chat is also pitched as helping create follow-ups (otter-docs-1), and the Claude MCP integration can draft follow-ups (otter-docs-16), so the core drafting capability is documented. missing for 10: evidence of an in-product review-and-send flow (sending in a couple of clicks or email-client integration), detail on tier availability beyond the enterprise page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
